verdict.rationale: PagerDuty Advance embeds agentic AI across the platform, and users can hand off work to several named built-in agents. The SRE Agent diagnoses, troubleshoots and remediates incidents and can be extended with Skills, GitHub and Sentry. The Scribe Agent can be scheduled to join incident calls and record decisions, the Shift Agent coordinates schedule changes without manual intervention, and the Insights Agent offers on-demand conversational analytics. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of how well the agents perform delegated tasks, and detail on the interactive delegation flow (how users ad hoc assign or approve agent actions in the UI).
